what: Initial UNKNOWN retry does not re-run the BEHIND gate before CI
scenario_or_breakage: When the first gh pr view returns UNKNOWN and a retry resolves to BEHIND, the proposed flow falls through to refresh_ci_state before the non-admin merge-state gate; if CI is not passing it emits ci_not_ready instead of main_advanced, so the caller polls CI instead of rebasing an out-of-date branch.
suggested_fix: After retry_pr_info_unknown_recovery 4 and the persistent empty/UNKNOWN error check, re-check MERGE_STATE=BEHIND and exit with the same main_advanced/empty ERROR behavior as the original BEHIND gate; add a G-case where UNKNOWN resolves to BEHIND with failing CI and assert no checks/merge commands.
